response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software developer with a strong background in TypeScript, Node.js, and general software craftsmanship, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or performance/power trade-off analysis for chips, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering experience (15+ years)
Strong low-level systems experience with DLang for high-performance, low-latency services
Demonstrated leadership via open-source projects, workshops, and technical talks
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture work
No experience with AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU/accelerator performance analysis
Entire career is web/backend/mobile focused, not hardware-software co-design

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
